name: Phantom Click
description: Learns the clicks you die to and catches early clicks there - GD only gets them on the right tick. Death ranges, live per-range ticks from the console, and trajectory overlays.

enabled.name: Catch early clicks
enabled.description: Catch clicks that land a few ticks early at clicks you've died to, and give them to GD on the right tick. Learning, death logging and trails keep running when this is off.

buffer-ticks.name: Default ticks per range
buffer-ticks.description: How many ticks early a click may be in any death range that doesn't have its own setting. Set ranges one by one with the console tool (python phantom.py). A caught click is never held longer than this.

range-width.name: Death range width (%)
range-width.description: Each death counts toward a range this wide, centred on a whole percent. 1 means a death at 51% belongs to 50.5-51.5%.

min-misses.name: Misses before buffering
min-misses.description: How many times a click must kill you before the buffer turns on for it.

judge-seconds.name: Judge time (seconds)
judge-seconds.description: A click counts as a miss if you die within this time after it, and as a pass if you're still alive after it. Raise it if deaths come long after the click (long jumps, fast speeds).

merge-blocks.name: Same-click distance (blocks)
merge-blocks.description: Clicks this close together count as the same click.

count-practice.name: Count practice deaths
count-practice.description: Log practice-mode deaths and misses too. Practice passes always count, so practice is the quickest way to teach a click.

overlay.name: Show overlay
overlay.description: Draw your death ranges, deaths, learned right ticks and trails inside the level. Green = buffer ON, amber = learning, red = deaths only, blue = delay range, grey = off.

overlay-trails.name: Show trails
overlay-trails.description: Draw your best run (green, with your clicks) and your last attempt (white) on the overlay.

log-events.name: Console log
log-events.description: Print deaths, ranges, learning, caught clicks and level summaries to the Geode console.
